name: PrepareCustomerSummaries
description: First step of the daily customer summaries (code). Picks the customers to summarise — one customerCode, or every customer with an open balance, an open task or an open promise — and computes each one's facts as of asOfDate: open balance, overdue amount and oldest overdue days (Invoices layer), open commitment (CustomerNotes התחייבות לתשלום, outcome פתוחה: amount and date), commitments not kept or partly kept (with what came in and what is left), active notes, open disputes, open tasks (CollectionQueue ממתין / בטיפול titles), latest customer note, last contact (Interactions / CustomerNotes / InboundEmails). Returns a Hebrew prompt for Iris (CustomerCardAgent) starting with "משימה: סיכום יומי ללקוחות", one line per customer, plus the facts per customer for WriteCustomerSummaries. Reads only; writes nothing.

customerCode.description: Only this customer (the card's refresh button). Default: every customer with an open balance, task or promise

asOfDate.description: Clock for tests: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in Asia/Jerusalem

hasCustomers.description: False when there is nothing to summarise; the run then skips the agent
